description: This file implements an unbounded buffer for concurrent use within gRPC, providing thread-safe methods to add, load, retrieve, and close the buffer.

classes.name: Unbounded
classes.description: A thread-safe, unbounded buffer supporting concurrent Put, Load, Get, and Close operations.

methods.name: NewUnbounded
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of Unbounded buffer.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Adds an item to the buffer; returns error if buffer is closing.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the next item from backlog into the channel, or closes the channel if buffer is closing and empty.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the read-only channel for consuming buffered items.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the buffer, preventing further Put operations and closing the channel after draining.
